title: PU-12M lesson 4: the operator-plotter
status: A seat lesson (docs/TUTORIALS.md): step by step, each control highlighted, the next step only once it is done.
source: sam3d; the moves, their order and their waits are the console's procedures (data/procedures/pu12m.json: none (the post deployed)) and the crew data's reports (data/crew/pu12m_crew.json), with their sources
notes: The post starts deployed; the targets come in on cue.

steps.title: The operator-plotter's seat
lines: You are the operator-plotter (No. 2): on the bench, in the middle.

The regiment's radars send the air picture to the post by telecode; it shows on the IT-45 tube. You write each target on the air-situation board, so that the battery commander can give it to a launcher.
Each step lights up what to use; only that works. Read, then press Enter.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: The air-situation board
lines: In front of you: the board, a map under glass. The targets you plot are written on it, with their number, height and time.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The IT-45 tube
lines: At your right: the IT-45, the round tube with the regiment's picture. Each target is a mark with its number.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The telecode receiver
lines: At your left, the P receiver: the telecode coming in from the regiment.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: A target
lines: A target comes in on the regiment's picture.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: Pick it: ]
lines: Press ] (or [) to pick a target on the tube: its number shows at the bottom of the screen.
steps.why: You plot one target at a time, the nearest first.

steps.title: Plot it: P
steps.wait_text: the target written on the board
lines: Press P: you write the picked target on the board. It takes a few seconds of handwork.
steps.why: The commander gives the launchers targets from the board: one that isn't written isn't given.

steps.title: Another
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: Pick it and plot it
lines: ] to pick it, P to plot it. Keep the board up to date: a target's mark is replotted as it moves.

steps.title: Keep plotting: the commander gives a target
lines: Keep the board up to date: pick and plot the targets again as they come closer.
The battery commander reads your board and gives a target to a launcher on the battery net once its fresh mark is within a launcher's reach: listen.
steps.why: He gives targets only from marks under two minutes old: an old mark is where the target was, not where it is.
steps.hint: ] pick, P plot, again every so often.

steps.title: The operator-plotter's part: done
lines: That is your part: the regiment's picture written on the board, target by target, for the commander.
Esc, then M: the missions menu, and the next seat's lesson.
